full.m_medallion_hot: close-up at a school gate in the morning, framed from the chin down to the chest of a young Filipina woman with long dark hair and light brown skin in a long dark coat with the collar open; on a cord at her neck hangs a small round bronze medallion engraved with a crescent moon, glowing hot orange-gold, sparks flying from it. Her arms are down, no hands in frame. Behind her shoulder a swirl of golden light opens in the air, and inside it the small dark silhouette of a slim dog with one folded ear and one upright ear. No writing, no letters. Single image, no panels, no border, the picture fills the whole vertical frame.
